nodes.text: Can every integer $N\geq 2$ be written as\[N=\frac{\prod_{1\leq i\leq k}(m+i)}{\prod_{1\leq i\leq k}(n+i)}\]for some $k\geq 2$ and $m\geq n+k$?

#686 : [Er79d] number theory If $n$ and $k$ are fixed then can one say anything about the set of integers so represented? See also [388] and [677] .
